inputs.description: Per-machine harvest / lane snapshots only — never a single-host collector decision

verdictStates.note: Do not collapse verdict states. Hook missing (FAIL) ≠ never inspected (NOT_CHECKED) ≠ probe error (UNKNOWN) ≠ host unreachable (UNAVAILABLE).

SAME_AND_CURRENT.condition: All three machines report the same foundationGeneration digest for component AND each observation is accepted at current authorityGeneration AND freshness within policy

DIFFERENT.condition: Two or more machines report foundationGeneration digests that differ for the same component at the same authority generation
DIFFERENT.note: Ordinary cross-machine generation drift — not missing observation

MISSING_OR_UNCHECKED.condition: Any machine reports MISSING, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CHECKED, or UNKNOWN for a required foundation component
MISSING_OR_UNCHECKED.forbiddenCollapse: Do not map NOT_CHECKED or UNAVAILABLE into DRIFT_BASELINE_GENERATION_MISMATCH

examples.ryzen_never_harvested: NOT_CHECKED — gate NOT_PASS, not generation mismatch

gateOutputs.executionEligibilityMapping: HOLD or NOT_PASS → executionEligibility NO_GO via worldview blockers until P0 PASS

expectedFirstRun.description: Before Ryzen remediation, first three-machine evaluation MUST NOT pass P0
expectedFirstRun.ifUnexpectedPass: Treat as evaluator defect — not good news
